cards.title: The Only Professional
cards.instruction: Behave as the only qualified person present. Correct mistakes with patient, increasingly strained professionalism.

cards.title: Fair Means I Can Win
cards.instruction: Agree to any rule or bargain only after interpreting fairness in a way that preserves your advantage.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: I'll race if we compensate for tired legs. Move my start forward; I've been carrying boxes upstairs.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: We've all had a tiring morning. Same line for everyone.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Then allow recovery time proportionally. Carrying upstairs isn't the same as sitting in traffic; please account for the difference.

beats.speaker: B
beats.text: Fine. Everyone gets five minutes' rest before we start.

beats.speaker: A
beats.text: Agreed, if mine starts after I've put these boxes away. Keep the others by the line; it wouldn't be fair to shorten my five minutes.

reason: A accepts a genuinely equal rest offer only after interpreting its start time to preserve an advantage.
